query.title: Search Query
query.description: What to search for on Etsy (e.g., 'handmade jewelry', 'vintage watch', 'ceramic mug')

searchUrl.title: Search URL (with filters)
searchUrl.description: Full Etsy search URL including filters and sort (e.g. is_best_seller, order=date_desc). When set, the actor opens this exact URL instead of typing only the q= keyword.

maxItems.title: Maximum Results
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to extract from search results (typical: 60-100 per search page)

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Filter products by minimum rating (1-5 stars)

minReviews.title: Minimum Reviews
minReviews.description: Filter products by minimum number of reviews
